text: Completed typed PyBIDS entity-presence parity: direct present/absent queries plus composable optional filters, a present-entity candidate index, README/first-contact docs, and REQUIRED/NONE count+checksum court cases. Added 400 generated fast-path/canonical and discovery-order checks on JVM+JS, strict compiler warning gates, MUnit 1.3/ScalaCheck, and CI coverage floors. Gates: 87 JVM + 69 JS tests on Scala 3.3.8/3.4.2/3.7.4; coverage 81.98% statements/72.93% branches; version policy and static checks pass. Full 6,281-file court matched 6,144 present and 137 absent paths; directional presence 42.05x and absence 3.94x vs PyBIDS 0.22.0.
